entities.summary: Chola, a notable figure in the history of Sri Lanka, associated with Polonnaruwa Kingdom (1070–1215). Preceded by Vijayabahu's Liberation and Parakramabahu the Great. Their legacy influenced Jaffna Kingdom and Polonnaruwa Decline and Drift Southward.
